features.text: Heavy-duty canvas construction delivers lasting protection and durability throughout the healing process
Specialized carpeted inner sole reduces wear while providing cushioned comfort during movement
Strategic D-ring closure system near toe area ensures secure positioning of the cast
Flexible upper strap adapts to cast size while maintaining consistent support
Slip-resistant sole design with hook and loop closure for safe, stable mobility

measurement: Refer to our sizing chart for proper measurements, or visit our Perfect Fit Promise page for personalized fitting assistance from our medical team. Proper sizing ensures maximum protection and stability.
